title: Termwise constant-scalar restriction and normalized adjunction comparisons
statement: Let schemes lie in universe $u$, let $C_n$ be commutative rings in universe $u+1$ with arbitrary transitions $\tau_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$, and use the actual semilinear-system operations $P,R,J$ [def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations, def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons]. Fix a commutative ring $B$ in universe $u+1$ and maps $\varphi_n:B\to C_n$ with $\tau_n\varphi_{n+1}=\varphi_n$. Using module-sheaf scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], define $\rho$ to constant-$B$ strict towers [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension] by restricting each component action along $\varphi_n$ and retaining every underlying section and horizontal transition. Take its exact localization on derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The ordinary direct-image scalar comparison is the identity on every pulled-back component section. Define the inverse-image scalar comparison as its ordinary adjunction transpose, inverted and localized; define $\rho R\to R\rho$ as its derived adjunction mate. For an open immersion, define $J\rho\cong\rho J$ by the inverse of the open-adjunction inverse mate of the same inverse-image comparison [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. These constructions fix the named $\rho$, $\rho P$, $\rho R$ and $\rho J$ comparisons and their ordinary section/adjunction normalizations. This definition asserts neither proper/open mate preservation nor any evaluation or pasting equation.
